# Zed Welcome reference

welcome.rs is copied byte for byte from Zed v1.23.2, commit c0199504b9cce79bc27524950022ed701bc3ebd5.
Source: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/c0199504b9cce79bc27524950022ed701bc3ebd5/crates/workspace/src/welcome.rs
License: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/v1.23.2/LICENSE-GPL

The reference centers quiet section lists on the editor background, places keybindings beside action labels, and limits recent projects to five.
Story #29 intentionally substitutes New Claude Chat for New File, calls the recent section Recent, omits Configure and other actions, and uses workspace tabs instead of windows.
Keymaps remain pinned under tests/fixtures/zed-keymaps/.
No stock Zed screenshot was captured during sandbox authoring.
The developer must provide a screenshot beside stock Zed before building the rest of the feature.
